info.title: Boring Things foundation
info.description: Owner-scoped manual Things. Import, discovery and assistant execution follow later.

get.description: Returns sign-in settings, upload limits and feature availability for the browser client.
Returns the signed-in user's profile and whether sample data has been added.

post.description: Adds sample Things, activities and purchasables, then returns the updated profile. Repeated requests preserve the existing sample collection. Returns 404 when sample data is disabled.

get.description: Lists Thing categories with the number of your Things in each category.
Lists field sets, optionally filtered by category and search text.
Returns a field set with its field definitions, required dependencies and suggested related sets.
Lists reusable field definitions, optionally filtered by search text.
Returns a field definition with its validation rules, display settings and sensitivity.

Lists Thing summaries, optionally filtered by category, tag and search text. Results default to most recently updated first, with ties ordered by ID. A Thing is displayed as new for seven days after creation.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order; defaults to UPDATED. Applied before pagination.

post.description: Creates a Thing with the supplied category, fields, tags and pins. Accepts an optional client-generated UUID; an ID already in use returns 409.

get.description: Returns a Thing with its fields, linked resources and current import status. Sensitive field values are masked.

patch.description: Updates selected properties, fields, tags and pins of a Thing. Removing a populated field set or changing category preserves displaced values as custom fields. Returns 409 while an import is active.

delete.description: Deletes a Thing. Returns 409 while an import is active.

post.description: Returns the stored value of a selected field, including sensitive values masked in Thing responses. The response must not be cached.

get.description: Lists labels available for organising Things.

post.description: Creates a label for organising Things. Accepts an optional client-generated UUID; an ID already in use returns 409.

patch.description: Renames a tag across all Things that use it. Whitespace-only names are rejected.

delete.description: Deletes a tag and removes it from the Things that use it.

get.description: Lists attachment metadata, optionally filtered to files linked to a Thing.

post.description: Uploads one file in the multipart file field and returns its metadata. File size, media type and content must satisfy the limits returned by getConfig.

get.description: Returns attachment metadata and the IDs of linked Things.

delete.description: Deletes an attachment and its stored file. Returns 409 while the attachment is linked to a Thing or referenced by an import.

patch.description: Updates selected attachment properties across all linked Things. Omitted properties keep their values; null removes a value. Automatic document processing preserves values edited or removed by the user.

get.description: Downloads the stored file using its media type and filename.

put.description: Links an attachment to a Thing. Repeating an existing link succeeds. Returns 409 while the Thing has an active import.

delete.description: Removes the link between an attachment and a Thing, retaining the attachment. Returns 409 while the Thing has an active import.

get.description: Lists issues, optionally filtered by Thing and resolution status.

post.description: Creates an issue for a Thing, with status OPEN by default. Accepts an optional client-generated UUID; an ID already in use returns 409.

get.description: Returns an issue with its status, due date and resolution timestamp.

patch.description: Updates selected issue properties. Resolving an open issue records the resolution time; reopening it removes that timestamp. Null removes the status text or due date.

get.description: Lists events by schedule, earliest first, then ID, with unscheduled events last. Filters can select a Thing, status or date range. Date-only events sort at midnight in timeZone. Range bounds are inclusive: timed events use instants, and date-only events use the calendar date of each bound in timeZone.

parameters.name: timeZone
parameters.description: IANA timezone used to compare date-only events to from/to and order mixed schedules. Defaults to UTC.

post.description: Creates an event for a Thing, with status SUGGESTED by default. Scheduled events require a date or timestamp. A linked issue must belong to the same Thing. Accepts an optional client-generated UUID; an ID already in use returns 409.

get.description: Returns an event with its schedule, completion timestamp and supporting sources.

patch.description: Updates selected event properties. When switching between a date and timestamp, set the previous schedule property to null. Scheduled events require one schedule value. A linked issue must belong to the same Thing.

get.description: Lists opportunities to buy products that maintain or improve a Thing, optionally filtered by Thing and suggestion kind.
Returns a purchasable opportunity with its merchant link, price when available and supporting sources. Merchant actions for sample suggestions are disabled.

Lists conversation summaries, most recent message first, then ID. Omitting thingId includes conversations with and without Thing context. minMessageCount can exclude empty conversations. Page contents can shift when messages or conversations are added between requests.

parameters.name: minMessageCount
parameters.description: Minimum persisted message count, including user and assistant messages in every status. Use 1 to exclude empty conversations.

post.description: Creates a conversation, optionally associated with a Thing. Accepts an optional client-generated UUID; an ID already in use returns 409.

get.description: Returns a conversation and its messages in chronological order. Resource cards indicate whether their referenced records are still available.

post.description: Queues document processing for an uploaded attachment and links it to the target Thing. Omitting thingId creates a placeholder Thing. Returns 409 if the target already has an active import.

get.description: Returns import progress, detected candidates, resulting Thing IDs and any processing error.

post.description: Selects detected Things to import and resumes processing. Each selection can update an existing Thing or create one. Returns 409 unless the import is awaiting selection.

Queues another attempt for a failed or incomplete import, or retries optional research on a completed import with warnings. Reuses saved progress and completed document batches. Returns 409 if there is no work to retry, a target was deleted or a target has another active import.

get.description: Streams Thing updates as server-sent events. Each thing.snapshot event contains a complete Thing; replace local state with the snapshot on connection or reconnect.

200.description: Full masked Thing snapshots; event: thing.snapshot; id: revision. Reconnect sends current persisted state.

post.description: Adds a user message and queues an assistant response. Repeating the same request ID and text returns the existing conversation or retries its latest failed response. Changed text, another response in progress or a full conversation returns 409.

get.description: Streams conversation updates as server-sent events. conversation.snapshot contains a Conversation and replaces local state on reconnect. conversation.delta contains a ConversationDelta with a message ID, text offset and text. Retry the latest failed response by sending the same request ID and text.

200.description: Active conversation snapshots (conversation.snapshot) and text deltas (conversation.delta). Reconnect restores saved messages and current transient text; deltas include message ID and offset.

post.description: Records a user opening a Thing page by incrementing accessCount and setting lastViewedAt to the server time. Each successful request counts once, so clients must not automatically retry. Reading or streaming a Thing does not record a view. Recording a view preserves updatedAt and the content revision.

Error.description: HTTP error status and a message suitable for display to the user.

Money.description: Amount in integer minor units and a supported currency with two decimal places.

Value.description: A text, numeric, boolean or money value. Identifiers retain their string representation.

NullableValue.description: A field value, or null for an empty, removed or masked value.

SourceRef.description: Attachment or public URL supporting a value, with an optional page and quote. Sensitive field quotes may be omitted.

Pin.description: Reference to a field selected for prominent display on a Thing.

FieldSchema.description: Supported JSON Schema rules for validating a field value.

FieldDefinition.description: Reusable field definition with validation rules, display settings and sensitivity.

icon.description: Semantic field icon key; the Remix mapping is documented in README.md. Clients may render a generic field icon for missing, null or unrecognised keys.

instanceSpecific.description: Whether the value belongs to the owned item, account or agreement. Only false values participate in public research; unclassified fields default to true.

Field.description: Field definition with its current value, source information and masking state.

icon.description: Semantic field icon key; the Remix mapping is documented in README.md. Clients may render a generic field icon for missing, null or unrecognised keys.

instanceSpecific.description: Whether the value belongs to the owned item, account or agreement. Only false values participate in public research; unclassified fields default to true.

FieldSet.description: Category-specific group of field definitions, required dependencies and suggested related sets.

DetailFieldSet.description: Selected field set with current values and source information for each field.

CustomField.description: Custom field with its value, sensitivity and source information.

instanceSpecific.description: Whether the value belongs to the owned item, account or agreement. Only false values participate in public research; unclassified fields default to true.

Category.description: Thing category with display settings and the number of your Things in that category.

icon.description: Semantic category icon key. Clients map keys to their icon catalogue.

Profile.description: Signed-in user profile and whether sample data has been added.

Config.description: Browser sign-in settings, upload limits and feature availability.

TagInput.description: Tag name and optional ID for creation. Whitespace-only names are rejected.

id.description: Optional client-generated ID for creation. Omit to generate an ID on the server. An existing ID returns 409. Ignored on PATCH; the path ID is authoritative.

ThingSummary.description: Thing metadata for lists, including category, tags and view counts.

accessCount.description: Number of explicit user views recorded for this Thing.

lastViewedAt.description: Most recent explicit user view; null until first viewed.

Thing.description: Thing details with fields, linked resource IDs and import status. Sensitive field values are masked.

warnings.description: Warnings for unfinished optional research. Imported fields and successful documents remain available.

accessCount.description: Number of explicit user views recorded for this Thing.

lastViewedAt.description: Most recent explicit user view; null until first viewed.

ValuePatch.description: Update to a field in a set or a standalone field. Null removes its stored value.

CustomFieldPatch.description: Update to a custom field, including its label, value, sensitivity and optional research classification. Omitted classification preserves an existing value or defaults to instance-specific.

instanceSpecific.description: Whether the value belongs to the owned item, account or agreement. Only false values participate in public research; unclassified fields default to true.

ThingCreate.description: Properties for creating a Thing, including its category and optional fields, tags and pins.

id.description: Optional client-generated ID for creation. Omit to generate an ID on the server. An existing ID returns 409.

ThingPatch.description: Selected Thing properties to update. Omitted properties keep their current values.

RevealRequest.description: Reference to the field whose stored value should be revealed.

RevealResult.description: Stored field value returned by an explicit reveal request. The response must not be cached.

Attachment.description: File metadata, document properties and IDs of linked Things.

title.description: Display title; null displays the original filename.

publisher.description: Manufacturer, retailer or organisation that issued the document.

documentDate.description: Original document date, independent of upload time.

pageCount.description: PDF page count derived from the file. Null for non-PDF, unparsed, malformed or encrypted files.

Issue.description: Problem associated with a Thing, including status, due date and resolution time.

statusText.description: Optional freeform status shown on an Issue card. Null clears it.

dueDate.description: Optional calendar due date, without a time or timezone. Null clears it.

IssueInput.description: Properties for creating an issue for a Thing. Status defaults to OPEN.

id.description: Optional client-generated ID for creation. Omit to generate an ID on the server. An existing ID returns 409.

statusText.description: Optional freeform status shown on an Issue card. Null clears it.

dueDate.description: Optional calendar due date, without a time or timezone. Null clears it.

IssuePatch.description: Selected issue properties to update. Null removes optional text or dates.

statusText.description: Optional freeform status shown on an Issue card. Null clears it.

dueDate.description: Optional calendar due date, without a time or timezone. Null clears it.

Event.description: Task or reminder for a Thing, with its schedule, completion time and supporting sources. SCHEDULED requires either startsOn or startsAt; other statuses allow neither. Both schedule properties cannot have a value together.

startsOn.description: Calendar date for an event without a time. Mutually exclusive with startsAt. When switching, clear the other field explicitly.

EventInput.description: Properties for creating an event for a Thing. Status defaults to SUGGESTED. SCHEDULED requires either startsOn or startsAt; both schedule properties cannot have a value together.

id.description: Optional client-generated ID for creation. Omit to generate an ID on the server. An existing ID returns 409.

startsOn.description: Calendar date for an event without a time. Mutually exclusive with startsAt. When switching, clear the other field explicitly.

EventPatch.description: Selected event properties to update. Null removes an optional issue link or schedule value. SCHEDULED requires either startsOn or startsAt; when switching, set the previous schedule property to null.

startsOn.description: Calendar date for an event without a time. Mutually exclusive with startsAt. When switching, clear the other field explicitly.

Purchasable.description: Opportunity to buy a consumable, accessory or upgrade that maintains or improves a Thing, with supporting sources. Merchant actions for samples are disabled.

Message.description: Conversation message with its text, resource cards, supporting sources and processing status.

sourceRefs.description: Empty in conversation responses: attachment references are represented by document cards and web citations appear as inline links in text.

Conversation.description: Conversation with optional Thing context and its messages.

ConversationSummary.description: Conversation details for history lists, including a title from the first user message, message count and timestamps.

title.description: First user message ordered by creation time then ID, trimmed and truncated to 80 Unicode code points. Null when there is no user message.

messageCount.description: Number of persisted user and assistant messages in every status. Retries reuse existing messages.

lastMessageAt.description: Newest message creation time, or conversation creation time when empty. Completing or retrying a message does not change this time.

ConversationSummaryList.description: A page of conversation summaries. nextCursor is null when no further page is available.

ConversationInput.description: Optional ID and Thing context for a new conversation.

id.description: Optional client-generated ID for creation. Omit to generate an ID on the server. An existing ID returns 409.

CategoryList.description: A page of categories. nextCursor is null when no further page is available.

FieldSetList.description: A page of field sets. nextCursor is null when no further page is available.

FieldDefinitionList.description: A page of field definitions. nextCursor is null when no further page is available.

ThingSummaryList.description: A page of Thing summaries. nextCursor is null when no further page is available.

TagList.description: A page of tags. nextCursor is null when no further page is available.

AttachmentList.description: A page of attachments. nextCursor is null when no further page is available.

IssueList.description: A page of issues. nextCursor is null when no further page is available.

EventList.description: A page of events. nextCursor is null when no further page is available.

PurchasableList.description: A page of product suggestions. nextCursor is null when no further page is available.

ImportCandidate.description: Thing detected in an attachment and offered for confirmation.

ImportUsage.description: AI model, token counts, elapsed time and tool results for a processing attempt.

entries.description: Per-request task, model, token counts and latency, including retries. Older jobs may omit these entries.

Import.description: Import status, detected candidates, resulting Thing IDs and processing details.

warnings.description: Warnings for unfinished optional research. Imported fields and successful documents remain available.

ImportStart.description: Attachment to process and an optional existing Thing to update.

ImportAccepted.description: Queued import ID, target Thing ID and initial status.

ImportConfirmation.description: Detected candidates selected for import. Each targetThingId identifies an existing Thing or is null to create one.

ResourceCard.description: Reference to a Thing, field, attachment, issue, event or product suggestion. Availability indicates whether the referenced record can still be accessed.

fieldId.description: Registry field ID; null for a custom field.

customFieldId.description: Custom field ID from the referenced Thing. Present only when fieldId and fieldSetId are null.

pages.description: Distinct one-based pages cited from this attachment, in ascending order. The page property retains the first cited page.

MessageInput.description: User message and request ID. Reuse the ID and text to retry the same message.

ConversationDelta.description: Streamed text fragment with its message ID and offset in the message text.

ThingAccess.description: View count and last-viewed timestamp after recording a user opening a Thing.

accessCount.description: Number of explicit user views recorded for this Thing.

lastViewedAt.description: Most recent explicit user view; null until first viewed.

AttachmentPatch.description: Selected attachment properties to update. Omitted properties keep their values; null removes a value. Automatic document processing preserves values edited or removed by the user. Filename, file content and page count are read-only.

title.description: Display title; null displays the original filename.

publisher.description: Manufacturer, retailer or organisation that issued the document.

documentDate.description: Original document date, independent of upload time.

AttachmentMetadataSource.description: Origin and supporting sources for an attachment property. USER also records values explicitly removed by the user.

AttachmentMetadataSources.description: Source information for each attachment property. An absent entry means its origin is unknown. Extracted quotes are omitted.

AiUsageEntry.description: Usage for one provider request, identified by task and model.

ImportWarning.description: A research operation that could not complete, with a generic reason and optional public source URL.

sourceUrl.description: Cited public document URL, or null for a search or overall processing warning.

retryable.description: Whether another attempt may succeed without changing the document limits.

actual.description: Observed byte size, text character count or page count, when known.

limit.description: Applicable byte, text character or page limit, when known.

IssueStatusEnum.description: Whether an issue is open or resolved.

EventStatusEnum.description: Whether an event is suggested, scheduled, completed or dismissed.

PurchasableKindEnum.description: Type of product suggestion: consumable, accessory or upgrade.

SchemaTypeEnum.description: JSON data type accepted by a field validation schema.

SchemaFormatEnum.description: Date or timestamp format accepted by a field validation schema.

UiHintEnum.description: Suggested input control for displaying and editing a field.

FieldOriginEnum.description: Whether a field value was entered by the user, extracted from an uploaded source or enriched from a reference document.

ValueTypeEnum.description: Data type of a custom field value.

ImportStatusEnum.description: Current stage or outcome of document processing. COMPLETE can include warnings for unfinished optional research.

MessageRoleEnum.description: Whether a message was written by the user or the assistant.

MessageStatusEnum.description: Current processing state of a conversation message.

ThingSortEnum.description: Descending Thing list order. MOST_VIEWED breaks ties by lastViewedAt; all orders finally break ties by ID. Unviewed Things sort last for RECENTLY_VIEWED.

AttachmentDocumentTypeEnum.description: Document classification, such as a manual, receipt or invoice. Null on an Attachment means unknown.

AttachmentMetadataOriginEnum.description: Whether attachment metadata came from a user edit, an import or source discovery.

ImportWarningCodeEnum.description: Reason an optional research operation could not complete. PAGE_BUDGET identifies persisted page-limited imports.

Unauthorized.description: A valid bearer token is required.

NotFound.description: The resource is missing, inaccessible or disabled.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with current state or an existing record.

TooLarge.description: The uploaded file exceeds the configured limit.

UnsupportedMedia.description: The file or request media type is unsupported.

InvalidInput.description: The request or a referenced value is invalid.

Unavailable.description: The requested capability is not configured or available.

ServerError.description: The request failed; private diagnostics are omitted.

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

search.name: q
search.description: Text used to search matching records.

thingId.name: thingId
thingId.description: Filter by Thing. Missing or inaccessible Things return an empty list.

tags.name: Things
tags.description: Thing records, fields and sensitive-value access.

tags.name: Registry
tags.description: Authored categories, field sets and field definitions.

tags.name: Attachments
tags.description: Private files and their Thing links.

tags.name: Activity
tags.description: Managed issues and events, including suggested tasks.

tags.name: Purchasables
tags.description: Opportunities to buy products that maintain or improve a Thing.

tags.name: Conversations
tags.description: Assistant conversations, messages and live updates.

tags.name: Profile
tags.description: Owner profile and opt-in demonstration data.
